workloads.name: quickjs-loop
args: let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < 250000; i++) s = (s + ((i * 17) % 97)) | 0; console.log("quickjs-loop:" + s);

workloads.name: cpython-json
workloads.description: Parse and serialize JSON repeatedly in CPython.
args: import json; data=[{"i":i,"s":str(i)} for i in range(800)]; total=sum(len(json.loads(json.dumps(data,separators=(",",":")))) for _ in range(40)); print(f"cpython-json:{total}")
import json; data=[{"i":i,"s":str(i)} for i in range(800)]; total=sum(len(json.loads(json.dumps(data,separators=(",",":")))) for _ in range(40)); print(f"cpython-json:{total}")

workloads.name: cpython-regex
workloads.description: Regex and text processing loop in CPython.
args: import re; text=("alpha123 beta456 gamma789 delta000\n"*2000); total=sum(len(re.findall(r"[a-z]+\d+", text)) for _ in range(80)); print(f"cpython-regex:{total}")
import re; text=("alpha123 beta456 gamma789 delta000\n"*2000); total=sum(len(re.findall(r"[a-z]+\d+", text)) for _ in range(80)); print(f"cpython-regex:{total}")

workloads.name: process-startup
workloads.command: i=0; while [ $i -lt 20 ]; do {dash} -c true; i=$((i+1)); done; echo process-startup:ok

workloads.name: fs-smallfiles
workloads.description: Create, read, and copy many small files.
workloads.command: dir=/bench-smallfiles-$HELIOS_PROCESS_ID; {mkdir} $dir; i=0; while [ $i -lt 64 ]; do echo data-$i > $dir/f$i; {cat} $dir/f$i > $dir/c$i; i=$((i+1)); done; echo fs-smallfiles:ok
